shots.picture: Peter sits on the left, Disciple in the center, and Early Believer on the right, all seated on reed mats around a low wooden table, facing forward with heads tilted back and eyes closed.
shots.action: Three distinct tongues of fire descend from the ceiling and rest on the heads of the three seated figures, illuminating their faces from above.

shots.picture: Peter sits alone in the frame, head tilted back, eyes closed, with a small flame hovering just above his curly grey-brown hair.
shots.action: The tongue of fire from above settles onto Peter's head, casting a bright warm glow on his face as he remains still in awe.
